title: Derivation
description: The declarative manifest of a single elbi derivation. This is the open standard; SDK implementations load this schema as data and validate against it rather than mirroring it in code.

specVersion.description: The version of the Open Derivation Spec this manifest conforms to.

kind.description: The manifest kind. Always 'Derivation' for this schema.

name.description: A stable, unique identifier for the derivation. Lower snake_case.

origin.description: Who authored the derivation: a human, or an agent via the authoring loop. Default 'human'.

status.description: Lifecycle/trust state. Only 'certified' derivations may be served to agents; 'proposed' ones await review. Default 'certified'.

description.description: Human- and agent-readable summary of what the derivation produces.

inputs.description: Named inputs the compute function reads. Keys are referenced inside compute as ctx.input(key).

dependsOn.description: Names of other derivations this one depends on. Normally inferred from inputs of kind 'derivation'; may be stated explicitly for ordering-only edges.

params.description: Typed parameters an agent supplies when running the derivation. When served over MCP these become the tool's input schema.

claim.description: The analytical conclusion this derivation asserts, as a mapping of verification column roles to output columns (e.g. {"x": "education", "y": "income"} for an effect, or {"variant": "arm", "metric": "converted"} for an A/B test). When present, the authoring loop runs the verification oracle on the derivation's output and certifies it only if the conclusion is sound: the inferential-soundness check that golden cases (which verify only computation) cannot provide.

contract.description: A DataContract the derivation's output must satisfy, embedded as a full DataContract manifest (see the Data Contract Spec). When present, the authoring loop checks the output against it and certifies only a sound result: the data-validity gate complementary to 'claim'. Validated against the Data Contract Spec independently.

type.description: The parameter's value type. 'object' is a record of named values; 'array' is a list (see 'items').

items.description: For type 'array', the element type. Nesting is bounded to one level: an array of scalars, or an array of records ('object').

required.description: Whether the agent must supply this parameter.

default.description: Value used when the parameter is not supplied.

kind.description: Whether this input is a raw dataset, the artifact of another derivation, or a governed semantic model.

ref.description: The name of the referenced dataset, derivation, or semantic model.

required.description: Whether the input must be bound for the derivation to run.

serve.description: The serve contract: how the derivation's artifact is presented to an agent over MCP.

columns.description: Optional explicit column projection and ordering.

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows exposed to the agent.

maxCells.description: Cell budget (rows x columns) for the inline preview; a portable proxy for a token budget. The full result remains available out of band (structured content / resource).
